description_en: Modifies the interval of asset synchronization configurations
description_zh: 修改资产刷新自定义周期配置
kebab_example: aliyun sas change-asset-refresh-task-config --asset-refresh-configs Status=1 SchedulePeriod=360 RefreshConfigType=2 Vendor=3 TargetId=2308 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeAssetRefreshTaskConfig

fields.help_en:
The type of the configuration. Valid values:

0: server synchronization task
1: cloud service synchronization task
2: scheduled AccessKey pair verification task
fields.help_zh:
配置类型。取值：
0：主机刷新任务
1：云产品刷新任务
2：AK定时校验任务
fields.name: refresh_config_type

fields.help_en:
The synchronization cycle. Valid values:

60: 60 minutes
180: 3 hours
360: 6 hours
720: 12 hours
1440: 1 day
10080: 7 days
fields.name: schedule_period

fields.help_en:
The status of the configuration. Valid values:

1: enabled
0: disabled
fields.help_zh:
配置开启状态。取值：
1：开启
0：关闭
fields.name: status

fields.help_en: The ID of the data entry containing the AccessKey pair that you specify when you configure the scheduled AccessKey pair verification task
fields.help_zh: 配置AK定时校验任务时，指定的AK记录的ID
fields.name: target_id

fields.help_en:
The service provider of the cloud asset. Valid values:

3: Tencent Cloud
4: Huawei Cloud
7: Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud
fields.help_zh:
云资产厂商。取值：

3：腾讯云
4：华为云
7：亚马逊云
fields.name: vendor

parameters.help_en: The region in which your Security Center service resides
parameters.name: region_id

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Data.description_zh:
修改是否成功。取值：
true：修改成功
false：修改失败

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
